component_units.freeform_ref_ll: mean teacher-forced reference-answer logprob per reference token on eval_freeform/dev.jsonl
component_units.mcq_gold_ll: mean option-set-normalized gold answer-letter logprob per MCQ item on data/val_v3.jsonl

rationale: Equal weighting is a frozen neutral starting prior for Phase 4: MCQ option-set-normalized gold-token LL and free-form reference LL each get one vote, with no tuning against dev results. The MCQ term is normalized over the four answer letters to avoid rare full-vocabulary letter-position collapse dominating the mean. #35 must still run the full real primary objective before this score is used by the accept/revert gate.
